_meta.description: Version-gated Drupal facts. Each fact applies when since <= version < until. Every entry cites a change record or core file; scripts/drupal-facts quotes the citation. Keep this list short: only facts that agents get wrong without it.

facts.statement: Hooks can be implemented as classes in src/Hook/ with the #[Hook] attribute on autowired services.
facts.note: Use #[LegacyHook] on the procedural shim for 10.x compatibility. Install/update hooks, hook_theme, hook_requirements, hook_hook_info stay procedural.

facts.statement: #[Hook] supports order (Order::First/Last, OrderBefore/After), #[ReorderHook], #[RemoveHook], and preprocess hooks.
facts.note: Secondary-sourced details; confirm the record before quoting specifics.

facts.statement: Themes can implement hooks with #[Hook] in their src/Hook/ directory.
Procedural hooks in .module files are still supported and not formally deprecated.
facts.note: Deprecation is planned; removal no earlier than Drupal 13. Do not rewrite procedural hooks unrequested.

facts.statement: Plugin discovery supports PHP attributes (e.g. #[Block], #[FieldType]) for core plugin types.
facts.note: Contrib plugin types may still require annotations; check the plugin manager of that type, not the core version.

facts.statement: Plugin types must provide an attribute class; annotation-only plugin types are deprecated (removal of annotation support in 13.0).
Recipes (recipe.yml with config actions) can be applied to a site.
facts.change_record: UNVERIFIED nid — see https://www.drupal.org/docs/extending-drupal/drupal-recipes and the 10.3.x change-record list

facts.statement: Entity queries must call accessCheck(TRUE|FALSE) explicitly; omitting it throws.
format_size() is deprecated (10.2) and removed in 11.0; use \Drupal\Core\StringTranslation\ByteSizeMarkup::create().
facts.note: since/until here mark the deprecation window: in >= 11.0 the function does not exist.

facts.statement: watchdog_exception() is deprecated (10.1) and removed in 11.0; use \Drupal\Core\Utility\Error::logException() with an injected logger.
system_time_zones() is deprecated (10.1) and removed in 11.0; use \Drupal\Core\Datetime\TimeZoneFormHelper.
Drupal 12 requires PHP 8.5 and an upgrade path from 11.4 or later.

facts.change_record: UNVERIFIED — reported by ai_best_practices and secondary sources; confirm the change record before relying on it
